description: Auxiliary Euro-Calliope datasets: Spatial data to represent a 98-node European energy system model is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Bryn Pickering (ETH Zurich). Subset of output generated with the possibility-for-electricity-autarky workflow which provides the same data as given by https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.3246302, but at a spatial resolution that does not strictly match administrative units in Europe. Three files are not generated with the possibility-for-electricity-autarky workflow: `nuts_to_regions.csv`, `transmission.csv`, and `units.png`. Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
